desc:
🌴 NEW: FLORIDA KEYS & DEEP SEA UPDATE! 🌴
🎣 Fish the real Lake Fork, Texas, then fly to the Florida Keys!

🎁 CODES (Settings):
✅ KEYS: FREE Florida Cash + Live Shrimp (Florida)
✅ 4KFAVS: FREE Cash + Live Bait
✅ 200KVISITS: FREE Cash + Live Bait

How to Play:
🎯 Cast to cover and work your lure until a fish strikes
⚡ SET THE HOOK and fight it without snapping your line
✈️ Reach level 15 and fly the seaplane to Florida
🐊 Airboat the Everglades for peacock bass and snakeheads
🏝️ Sight fish the flats for bonefish, redfish and permit
🌉 Battle giant tarpon under the Keys bridges
🦈 Run offshore for sharks, sailfish and blue marlin
🛒 Unlock better rods, reels, lures and boats
🏆 Win live tournaments against the whole server
👑 Rank up and top the leaderboards

🔥 Can you catch the legends? Old Timber, The Silver King, Big Blue and more…
👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite + join the group for a FREE Celestial Rod!
🎮 PC, Mobile and Console
